candidate_windows.window_text: We evaluate the proposed approaches on two tasks for predicting next agent turn, i.e., grounding generation and response generation. Given current turn, dialogue history and all available documents in the dataset, we aim to evaluate generated text along with intermediate retrieval results. We split the data into train/validation/test sets as shown in Table 3. The ratio between train and validation/test set is close to $5:1$ . Half of the dialogues in validation/test set are grounded in "unseen" documents in train set. All experiments were run with 1 V100 GPUs with half precision (FP16) training. More details about experimental settings and hyperparameters are reported in B.1 and B.2.

The implementation is in PyTorch. For fine-tuning RAG (Lewis et al., 2020), we follow the example<sup>4</sup> from HuggingFace and fine-tune it on our dataset for 16 epochs. For fine-tuning DPR (Karpukhin et al., 2020), we train DPR-nq on our dataset using facebookresearch/DPR<sup>5</sup>. Then, we integrate fine-tuned bi-encoder in RAG model facebook rag-token-nq<sup>6</sup>. For pre-trained DPR, we use the bi-encoder model trained on NQ dataset only from Facebook DPR checkpoint<sup>7</sup>. We train the models for 10 epochs and evaluate using the last checkpoint.

We fine-tune DPR for 50 epochs with a batch size of 128. We use a learning rate of 2e-05 using Adam, linear scheduling with warmup and dropout rate of 0.1. We set the max encoder sequence length to 128 consistent with the RAG model. We also use one additional BM25 negative passage per question in addition to in-batch negatives. We use gradient checkpointing to support a large batch size as 128. Table 7: The number of parameters of models.


Fine-tuned DPR For fine-tuning DPR, we experiment with different ways of obtaining hard negative examples. One is using the grounding of a dialogue query (grounding) as query, the other is using combined dialogue utterances (query) as query. The results turn out comparable as shown in Table 9. Domain Adaptation Setup We also experiment with domain adaption setup, where the train and validate splits are based on all data from the three domains and the test split is based on one unseen domain. The domain information is considered when retrieving relevant passage. The ratio of the number of examples in train and validation is $5:1$ . Task Description This writing task is to add necessary background information a conversational question to make it answerable and fit better in the context. In our tasks, a target turn is typically a query that can be answered by or based on the colored document titles and passage. See Figure 1 for an sample task. The target turn is typically unclear and underspecified, which needs to be modified by adding information based on the given document passage and dialog context. All turns should be written in English. There is NO chitchat such as "thank you##you are welcome". STEP-1: review the document including titles and passage; review dialogue context including previous and next turns; STEP-2: Please modify the target turn based on "passage" to make it an informative and answerable question that fits in the dialog context. Make sure to replace XXXX based on document topics typically indicated by "titles", and so on. STEP-3: if the target turn and next turn are obvious bad noise, please kindly write both target and next turn separated with ##. See Example (B) in next section. ![](images/590cd80368a10dd1c6a32cd5ff8fe84341d4043b8f4fd0e25b029dc8bb36b2d6.jpg) (a) The screenshot of task description and data collection interface of the crowdsourcing task.Rules and Examples (A) Often times, the target turn is underspecified, which makes it impossible to answer. Please improve it by adding more background information. In the example below, the target turn "and where do I have to make that request?" didn't explain what kind of request it. So, we need to add more information as in suggested modification.
TITLE: Register a leased vehicle If the dealer does not provide the proofs to the DMV, you must register the vehicle. Please complete the Document Guide to make sure you bring the correct documents with you.
user: My vehicle was registered in New York, what insurance should I use? agent: All vehicles registered in New York must have New York State auto liability insurance coverage user: btw, I have another question forXXXX, and where do I have to make that request? agent: Take your completed registration application and additional documents to a local DMV office
Suggested modification: btw, I will also have a leased car to register soon. where do I have to make that request?
(B) When the target turn or next turn appears to be obvious noise that is not comprehensible or fixable. In this case, please kindly write both user turn and agent turn in the same text form. You can simply separate them with _____. For example,
TITLE:The Impaired Driver Program - Alcohol & Drug Rehabilitation Program The Drinking Driver Program DDP is now called the Impaired Driver Program IDP. As this new name is being implemented, you may see the two names interchangeably. user: Yes, I sent two documents but It seems that either, those were wrong documents, or I missed some documents when I sent them. agent: Ok, no problem. I'll tell you what documents you need to send; if you already sent one of the documents on the list, simply send the ones you didn't send. DMV save all of that, so when you submit the ones you missed DMV will start your process. user: DDP; agent: sasdfsdf.
Suggested modification: I was looking for information for impaired driver program. Is IDP a new name for it? ##Yes, it is.
(C) Some turns seem to contain enough information but the wording doesn't fit in the dialogue context. The turn should be modified to fit in a dialogue context, such as removing previously unmentioned content "I might have lost them".
